protocol.fit_units: shared by physical side and sensor segment; training volunteers only
protocol.clock_primary: median gyro-derived event lag over training records in each side/segment; apply unchanged to held-out records
protocol.clock_oracle: held-out gyro/optical rotation cross-correlation is diagnostic only and never used for primary scoring or calibration
protocol.basis: published PHYTMO IMU-to-board basis, with train-fitted bounded correction
protocol.offset: board-local rigid sensor origin fitted on training records
protocol.filter: existing SG window 11, polynomial order 3; no fitted filter parameter
protocol.cohort: same continuous optical/IMU spans and samples for baseline and calibrated waveform metrics

notes: The legacy simulation gate remains unchanged; its unmatched 0/84 result is not a before/after effect estimate.
The held-out waveform gate applies only to matched original-site waveforms. A failed timing gate blocks validation claims even when oracle-assisted diagnostic errors improve.
No ADXL335 transfer correction is applied because these are NGIMU source recordings and no hardware reference capture exists.
